conditional_families.trigger: Information constraints, disclosure/access/use or allowance history is relevant

conditional_families.trigger: A frozen package/projection/commit or assurance claim is prepared/published

conditional_families.trigger: Mutable selection/pointer is requested, changed, observed or claimed

conditional_families.trigger: Retrieval/retention/access changes or cleanup/erasure claims occur

applicability_rules.applies: Payload or explicit scoped missingness required; dependent operation/claim withheld when necessary facts are missing.

applicability_rules.visible_trigger: Cannot be waived by generic unexamined coverage.
applicability_rules.family_vs_suboperation: A family may apply for an assessment while an effectful suboperation such as cancellation, resend or cleanup was not requested.
